note: FALSE POSITIVE from the 2026-07-19 MCP scan (aiwg@2026.7.13). A banner-delimited installer that appends shell ALIASES (not just `export PATH`) to a shell rc — the documented convenience installer idiom, adjacent to the shell-completion and PATH-append cases already handled. pkgxray fires persistence HIGH. RETUNE DEFERRED: the current PATH-install downgrade (see inspectPersistence) only covers `export PATH`; extending the same 'benign-if-no-exec/download-payload' rule to banner-delimited `alias`/`function` blocks is a straightforward next step, deferred so it can be reviewed on its own. Ground truth `review` (a rc write is worth a glance). Remove knownFalsePositive once inspectPersistence's soft-context covers alias installers.

sourceFiles.install.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
rc="$HOME/.zshrc"
if ! grep -qF '# --- mytool aliases (begin) ---' "$rc" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo '# --- mytool aliases (begin) ---' >> "$rc"
  echo 'alias mt="mytool"' >> "$rc"
  echo 'alias mtl="mytool list"' >> "$rc"
  echo '# --- mytool aliases (end) ---' >> "$rc"
fi
